generation.explanation: In \(y=A\sin(B(x-C))+D\), \(A\) controls amplitude, \(B\) controls frequency, \(C\) shifts the wave horizontally, and \(D\) shifts it vertically. Use the sliders to see each parameter reshape the same sine wave; the yellow point samples the curve at a movable \(x\)-value.
